scope: 1214fm (protocol 80, #117): 1214fl plus Domino linked outcomes. The native Domino network repeats a hit on each linked NPC with bit 40 of the damage flags set; on the client no replay matched that copy, it was refused as hit_damage_parameters and suppressed, and the linked guard lived in both worlds (carry-body-v1648a). The client now sends it as a Linked request with its declaration, native amount and flags, and the host applies it natively, with HostWorld and Dead sharing the outcome; unit tests cover the Linked request.
